## Fixed
- **Fabric in-game config screen.** Cloth Config has no Minecraft 26.2 build, so opening the config screen from ModMenu errored. The screen has been rebuilt as a native Minecraft options screen, so it works again on 26.2.

## Changed
- **Fabric no longer depends on Cloth Config.** Settings are now stored in `config/candy_dispenser.json` (plain JSON) and edited through the built-in screen via ModMenu. Existing values reset to defaults once on first launch after updating; re-set them in the new screen if you had customized them.

## Notes
- NeoForge is unchanged — it already used its own native config (`config/candy_dispenser-common.toml`) and was unaffected.
- No gameplay changes: the candy dispenser behaves exactly as in 2.1.2.
